Active incident - CORS errors for checkout extensions. Buyers unable to use checkout extensions that depend on app proxy. Gift cards and other checkout customizations affected. Holding statement issued.

Zendesk redesign - TMS solved-to-closed timing confirmed at 4 days. TMS-Plus legacy views being cleaned up. Active discussion with Jerie Shaw on group consolidation details.
NICE/Beacon status alignment issue (GH #6137) - still active, cross-team alignment discussion ongoing for all Tier 2 teams.
Dev Dashboard permissions guidance updated (PR #686255) - TMS missing-button article refreshed to clarify org roles vs store roles for Dev Dashboard access.
Legacy Plus TMS Zendesk trigger investigation - [NOTIFY] Plus TMS Escalations trigger references potentially defunct #plus-tms channel. Under review for deactivation.
Naming conventions discussion for SSA/TMS/ExOD - KM team cleanup requested, waiting on Sonal's confirmation on preferred terminology.
Blank escalations from Live Assist (GH #8128) - comms draft ready for Sonal to approve and post to #support-delivery-teams. Monitoring for recurrence.
